Recruitment Overview

Exciting opportunity in Himachal Pradesh: Apply for Junior Basic Teacher positions, with 600 vacancies available. The online application process is now open, running from March 16, 2026, to April 6, 2026. Eligible candidates can submit their applications after reviewing the official notification and ensuring they meet the required eligibility criteria, age limit, and other necessities. Visit RojgarResult.Com for detailed information and to access the application link, and take the first step towards a rewarding teaching career in Himachal Pradesh's esteemed education sector.

Junior Basic Teacher (JBT) Teacher 12th Any relevant field All India 18 - 45 50% EWS, General, OBC, SC, ST Seeking a dedicated educator with a strong foundation in elementary education. Qualifications include: 10+2 with 50% marks and a 2-year JBT or D.EI.ED course from a recognized HPBoSE-affiliated institute. Alternatively, candidates with Senior Secondary and 2-year JBT/D.EI.ED, or Graduation with 2-year JBT/D.EI.ED, or Post-Graduation with integrated B.Ed.-M.Ed. are eligible. A pass in the H.P. Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) is mandatory. Apply now to join our team of passionate teachers and inspire young minds.
